name: Dan Topping
bioAdditions: Daniel Reid Topping was part-owner and president of the New York Yankees 1945-1964 (S1), son of Henry Junkins Topping and grandson of John A. Topping of Republic Iron & Steel. Nothing found ties John A. Topping to the Southampton Toppings.
